user.title: Connect to Orbitly
user.description: Create a token in the Orbitly admin panel (Settings, Integrations) and paste it here.

data_description.token: Starts with ofha_. Read only, limited to the circles you chose.

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Orbitly token was revoked or expired. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Check the URL and that Home Assistant can connect to it.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. It may be revoked.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http:// or https:// address.
error.invalid_token_format: That does not look like an Orbitly token (ofha_...).

abort.already_configured: This server and token are already configured.

init.title: Orbitly options
init.description:
Paste this webhook URL into the token's Webhook setting in Orbitly: {webhook_url}
Then enter the signing secret Orbitly showed you to accept pushed events. Without it, events are still received by polling.
